long_biography.plain_text:
Yenin Acevedo sits at the centre of La Colonia's legal and operating structure. Since the main medical-centre company was incorporated in 2006, she has held its senior corporate offices while Jorge Acevedo served as director. Her remit now extends across the group's clinic network and pharmacy operations, where she carries formal ownership and executive responsibility.

La Colonia grew from a small Hialeah site into a system spanning Miami-Dade and Broward counties. Its model combines primary care, more than 20 specialties, diagnostics, dental treatment, pharmacy services and patient transportation for older Medicare beneficiaries. Acevedo also manages wellness, transport and investment entities connected with the enterprise. These positions distinguish her own contribution from her husband's founder role and show how family ownership was translated into a broad operating platform for senior healthcare.

uncertainties.detail: The upstream record directly links Acevedo to Never Blue and cites a classification-society registration to the family yacht entity. Florida's registry independently names Yenin and Jorge as managers of Acevedo's Yacht Holdings LLC at La Colonia's address, but the reviewed public state filing does not itself name Never Blue. The yacht is identity context only and is excluded from biography and wealth classifications.

Florida filings document Yenin's senior corporate role from the principal entity's 2006 incorporation and current 100% control. Official and newspaper histories name Jorge as founder and say the family helped build the platform. No source discloses whether Yenin co-created, financed, received or later acquired her stake, so origin remains Unknown.

The active corporation was filed in January 2006 under an earlier name and renamed La Colonia Medical Center in 2007, while company and interview histories describe the small branded clinic as beginning in 2010. The biographies say the company was incorporated in 2006 and avoid assigning a disputed single foundation year.

The upstream record supplies September 1968. Public-directory results suggest the middle initial M, but no strong reviewed source independently establishes the exact birth date, birthplace, birth country or expanded middle name. No proposal is made for those fields.

Several NPI records append FMG to Acevedo's name, but reviewed sources do not establish a personal medical licence, clinical practice or the intended expansion of that credential. She is described as an owner and corporate operator, not tagged or presented as a physician.

The upstream record contains the Instagram URL https://www.instagram.com/yeninmacevedo/. Search snippets do not independently expose enough profile content to re-verify the account, so it is preserved as existing input rather than proposed or used as evidence. No exact LinkedIn or personal website was verified.

The closed active catalogue has Medical devices, Pharmaceuticals and Physician but no broad clinic-ownership or healthcare-services tag. Acevedo operates clinics and a pharmacy rather than manufacturing pharmaceuticals or devices, and she is not established as a practicing physician. No tag is assigned and no individual candidate is created.
